senses.gloss: haṇa (IE 8-8; EI 8), Kannaḍa; same as Sanskrit paṇa; name of a coin.

Haṇḍikāpati (EI 5), epithet of a Brāhmaṇa donee; meaning uncertain. Haṇḍikā means ‘an earthern pot [for cooking]’, and the expression may mean ‘the head of a joint family (i. e. one responsible for feeding the family)’.
